1. Added a custom VOCDetectionTargetTransform class to convert VOC dataset annotation format (dictionary with 'annotation' and 'object' keys) to the format expected by Faster R-CNN (dictionary with 'boxes' and 'labels' tensors).

2. Used num_workers=0 in DataLoader to avoid multiprocessing issues when loading the dataset.

4. Mapped VOC class names to integer indices (1-20, plus 0 for background) matching the expected num_classes=21.

5. Simplified the training loop to test one batch only to avoid long execution times, while still verifying the setup works correctly.

The code now runs successfully without any crashes - the model, data loading, and forward pass all work correctly.
